blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A triangle's three angles always add to $180^\circ$, and its sides obey fixed rules. Right triangles have an extra tool, the Pythagorean theorem.

blocks.title: Classify triangles
items: Isosceles: at least 2 equal sides, base angles equal
Acute, right, obtuse: by the largest angle

blocks.title: Congruence rules
items: SAS: two sides and the angle between
ASA: two angles and the side between
AAA and SSA do not work

blocks.body: Three lengths form a triangle only if the two shorter ones add to more than the longest.
